description: This file defines the Polymer 'iron-meta' web component, which provides a monostate pattern for sharing metadata across the DOM. It includes the component's properties, methods, internal data structures, and usage examples, primarily written in HTML with embedded JavaScript.

classes.name: Polymer.IronMeta
classes.description: Defines the 'iron-meta' element, managing shared metadata of a specific type and key, with methods to register, unregister, and retrieve metadata.

classes.name: Polymer.IronMetaQuery
classes.description: Provides a query interface to retrieve metadata of a specific type and key from 'iron-meta' instances.

methods.name: byKey
methods.description: Retrieves meta data value by key within 'iron-meta'.

methods.name: getIronMeta
methods.description: Singleton factory method to access the shared 'iron-meta' instance.
